plan.angle: The top 10 splits between how-to-write-a-bug-report guides and static form templates. This page wins by showing a working bug report form that asks for steps, expected and actual results, and the build, then routes each report by severity and files it in the tracker, with four concrete teams using it.
tab_stories: Customer Reports: a customer of Quillfern Invoicing reports that invoice exports come out blank in Safari 18, gives 3 steps, a screenshot, and marks it as happening every time, and the report lands in the support queue tagged Exports.
QA Testing: QA tester Anselm Okafor-Reyes files a crash on Android build 4.12.0 during regression, and the app opens GitHub issue #2187 with his steps, the build and the Major label.
Beta Testers: Larkspur Games runs a closed beta of its puzzle game; 14 crash reports come in on build 0.9.3, the form asks for level and device, and sorting by level shows 11 of the 14 on level 6.

Critical Bugs: a store manager reports that checkout fails on the card step, picks Critical, and the app posts the report to the #on-call channel in Slack within the minute while Low reports wait for Thursday triage.

Report whether the bug reproduces at will, occasionally, or not at all (Mozilla)

A good summary quickly and uniquely identifies a bug report (Mozilla)
GitHub REST API: any user with pull access to a repository can create an issue
